notes.title: Café International released
notes.content:
[h2]Café International is ready for guests[/h2]

Café International welcomes guests from all countries. The strategic board game is released today and invites players to engage in exciting matches.

Four game modes (Classic, Solitaire, Play for Time and Local Multiplayer) are available. You'll find separate leaderboards for each mode.

In local multiplayer mode, you can play with friends over the Internet via "Steam Remote Play Together". If you have activated an audio channel to your friends, it is almost like sitting around the table together. With the right move, you can even trigger a scream or two from your opponents!

So do not wait any longer! Let's go to the first battle for the best seats in the "Café International"!

[h2]Press and Streamer requests[/h2]
Press inquiries for Keys please via our press kit page:
[url=https://ashgames.com/press/Cafe_International]https://ashgames.com/press/Cafe_International[/url]
or by e-mail to press@ashgames.com

Streamers who like board games and have a Keymailer account can request a key here:
[url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/73378]https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/73378[/url]
